statement: TRACE-MoE has higher 19-class macro-F1 than each baseline
evidence: TRACE-MoE per-class F1 significantly better (Holm p<0.05) than 1/4: bilstm_dnn +8.19 pts (p=3.96e-13), transformer +1.21 pts (p=0.133), rf -4.18 pts (p=0.133), tfsage_lite +0.69 pts (p=0.817)

statement: TRACE-MoE raises the recall of the weakest class (minimum class recall) over the best baseline
evidence: minimum class recall 10.43% vs best baseline rf 14.74% (gain -4.31 pts, needed 5)

statement: On binary detection TRACE-MoE is non-inferior to Random Forest
evidence: binary macro-F1 TRACE-MoE minus RF = +2.716 pts, 95% CI [+2.087, +3.344] over 5 seeds (margin -0.5 pts)

statement: Routing helps: one dense expert of the same size gives lower 19-class macro-F1
evidence: full minus dense expert: +0.28 pts per-class F1, Holm p=1; other variants: plain_ce_loss -0.81, protocol_routing -0.34, no_experts +0.63, no_hierarchy -0.12, no_balance_loss -0.53, no_protocol_token -0.05

statement: The experts specialise by attack family (NMI between expert and category)
Adversarially fine-tuned TRACE-MoE has a lower attack success rate than every baseline
evidence: TRACE-MoE per-class ASR significantly better (Holm p<0.05) than 1/3: bilstm_dnn +2.55 pts (p=0.00698), transformer +0.74 pts (p=0.582), tfsage_lite -0.45 pts (p=0.582)

statement: Adversarial fine-tuning costs little clean 19-class macro-F1
evidence: clean 19-class macro-F1 79.53% before and 79.56% after adversarial fine-tuning (drop -0.03 pts, allowed 1)

statement: The abstain score detects held-out attack types better than softmax confidence
evidence: abstain-score AUROC 72.61% vs softmax confidence 72.24% (needed >= 90%); held-out windows flagged unknown 51.7%, caught as attack or unknown 99.2%

statement: Abstention lowers the error on accepted traffic more than for any baseline (lowest AURC)
evidence: AURC (lower is better), rank 3/5: rf 0.042, transformer 1.101, trace_moe 1.215, bilstm_dnn 1.809, tfsage_lite 1.887

statement: TRACE-MoE is faster than the Transformer baseline and small enough for an edge gateway
evidence: 685,041 parameters (2.613 MB); 0.1493 ms/window on CPU at batch 1024 vs Transformer 0.0851 ms
